lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: دَحَىٰهَآ is in the derivative form: دَحَى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/ح/و-ي   d–ḥ–w/y to spread out, to level up, to widen, to enlarge, to relax. Of this root, دَحَا daḥā occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
دَحَى daḥā ū [v. trans.] to roll out, to spread out, to expand, to widen up

(79:30) وَالأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ دَحَاهَا and the Earth, after that, He spread [it] out.
